sentences.text: For a floating-rate loan to an individual for a non-business purpose that was sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, so there is no usual pre-payment penalty rate for this case.
The earlier directions on floating-rate term loans were withdrawn or repealed and are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
The directions that do apply for personal loans say pre-payment is allowed subject to extant instructions, but they do not state a charge rate for this case.
